item.title: Quantum Effects Stuttgart, Germany
item.description: Somya Rathee recently attended the Quantum Effects event in Stuttgart, where she participated in a panel discussion titled “Let’s get (Quantum) Physical! How Quantum Tech is Empowering Diverse Leadership and Workforce,” moderated by Dr. Stefan Seegerer. She was joined by esteemed panelists: Esperanza Cuenca Gómez, Developer Relations Manager for Quantum Computing at NVIDIA; Dr. Marta Pascual Estarellas, CEO of Qilimanjaro Quantum Tech; and Dr. Katrin Kobe, CEO of Bosch Quantum Sensing. Together, they discussed how to build a more inclusive and diverse leadership environment within the quantum computing field.

item.title: A Strong Kickoff for QuantumConnect Austria
item.description:
In June 2024, Alex Waldherr from Quantum Society Austria had the honor of participating in the QuantumConnect kickoff event in Vienna!

With over 70 participants from academia, politics, administration, startups, major law firms, industry leaders, publicly funded institutions, and media, the event showed just how much energy and momentum Austria’s quantum ecosystem already has. We are proud that our mission to strengthen education, research, and collaboration across all sectors resonated with such a diverse audience.

item.title: QCI-CAT: Connecting Quantum Research, Industry, and Society
item.description: From January 24th to 26th, QCIDays Vienna 2024 was held at the Federation of Austrian Industries, marking an important milestone in Austria’s quantum journey. Organized under the QCI-CAT research project, led by the Austrian Institute of Technology (AIT) and its consortium, the three-day event brought together leading figures from research, startups, academia, and industry. It provided a platform for collaboration, exchange of ideas, and discussions about the future of quantum communication infrastructures in Europe. Quantum Society Austria was proud to participate and contribute to the growing momentum of Austria’s quantum ecosystem.

item.title: Quantum Fall Fest 2023
item.description:
Quantum Fall Fest 2023, organized by Quantum Society Austria, held in TU Vienna on the 11th of November, was a resounding success, bringing together over 80 enthusiastic participants, including students and professionals, to explore the latest advancements in Quantum Computing. The event was a testament to the growing interest in this cutting-edge field and served as a platform for knowledge sharing and networking.

item.title: QSA Founder received Woman-of-the-Month Award
item.description:
QSA’s founder, Somya Rathee, was honored as the Woman-of-the-Month of ADV (Arbeitsgemeinschaft Datenverarbeitung), celebrating her outstanding contributions and leadership in the community! Congratulations!

Read the full article on the ADV website: Quantencomputing: Eine 18-Jährige gestaltet die IT-Zukunft mit.

This post was originally published on our old website and has been migrated here.

item.title: ADV Talk Quantum Machine Learning for Cyberspace
item.description: In the rapidly evolving digital landscape, the Austrian Digital Value Conference stands as a beacon of innovation and progress. This event brings together experts from various fields, fostering dialogue and collaboration in the pursuit of digital excellence. One of the highlights of the recent conference was the presentation by Quantum Society Austria. They delved into the fascinating world of Quantum Machine Learning in Cyberspace, sparking interest and curiosity among the attendees. This article provides an overview of the presentation and its impact on the audience, shedding light on the potential of quantum technology in our digital future. Let’s delve into the details.

item.title: Social Artificial Intelligence Night at FH St. Pölten
item.description: In April 2023, Quantum Society Austria made a significant contribution to the Social Artificial Intelligence Night at FH St. Pölten. They presented on the topic of Quantum Machine Learning (QML), a field with immense potential and wide-ranging applications. The talk focused on how QML could revolutionize sectors such as healthcare, finance, and cybersecurity, sparking interest among the diverse audience of students and industry leaders.
